sense.text:
It has been a very eventful week, and a lot of hatred has come out from our fellow brothers. “Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer”: some of these Israelite camps are murderers. They are teaching to hate IUIC, kill IUIC. Last week they tried to jump the brothers, and they got thumped up and the police hemmed them up too. That’s what happens, and people analyze why they get arrested: because they’re wrong. You don’t jump somebody and then think God is with you. That’s not in the Bible, where our forefathers did that.

“And ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.” Brothers that roll like that, Christ is not operating with them. They’re not getting eternal life, neither them nor the people that follow them. If you see us running around jumping other camps, jumping men and women, don’t follow us. We’re not the guys if that’s what we do.

The hatred is real, and the escalation is expected: Satan ain’t gonna stop as this knowledge and wisdom goes out.

Examine the leaders of these camps and look at what they’re teaching. Their teaching is not to benefit the nation of Israel, and it is not to glorify the Lord. Their teachings are of self-gratification: multiple women, having concubines, ‘I don’t work, but she go to work for me and bring the money back to me.’ In the world they would call that a gorilla pimp. That’s all it is: they have just transformed that from the world into Israel. Don’t get lost in this truth, and don’t get deceived.

Some people are so damn stupid. Here’s a brother walking down the street, two guys jump on him to rob him, and he beats both of them up. The police come and lock up the two guys, and these camps sit back and say, I need to sit down with all of you and make peace between y’all. That’s like a sister getting molested or raped, and you’ve got to sit down with the rapist and her and make peace. That’s stupid negro stuff.

“For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation”: they were ordained of old to this condemnation. “Ungodly men”: they are ungodly men, “turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness.” The grace of our Lord is the mercy he gave us, forgiveness for all our wickedness, and they turn it into lasciviousness, into the sexual: multiple wives and concubines and all of that, and rape. They teach it is now lawful to bust a woman upside the head and rape.

You might be asking what IUIC wants. We want to be left alone to do the Lord’s work, that’s it. It’s not gonna happen, because Satan is real.

“Evil men understand not judgment”: if you’re evil you won’t understand judgment. If you’re evil you’ll say, maybe he or she got robbed or raped and molested because God was against them, and we need to sit down with the rapist and the assaulter and everybody and make peace. There’s judgment that comes on the molester, judgment that comes on the attacker, judgment that comes on the rapist. There’s no judgment on the person that gets raped, no judgment on the one that gets assaulted, no judgment on those that get robbed.

Some black people are so freaking stupid; looking at the comments, are these people for real? Two-thirds of our people are freaking stupid. If that’s you, just leave; we don’t need you. We’re looking for the crème de la crème, the cream of the crop, the best of the best.

Today’s topic is Amalek and the liberal agenda, and it starts with who Esau is, for the people online who don’t know. Isaac “intreated the Lord for his wife, because she was barren”: she couldn’t have children. “And the Lord was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.”

“And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus?” If the Lord has blessed me, why am I having trouble in this pregnancy? “And she went to enquire of the Lord.”

“Two nations are in thy womb.” Genesis means the beginning; it is the beginning of all nations, and this goes into the last two nations the Lord was setting up: Jacob and Esau, Israel and Edom.

“And two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels”: what you want to highlight when you teach is separated. They are going to be separated. “And the one people shall be stronger than the other people”: able to endure great hardships. “And the elder shall serve the younger”: the one that’s firstborn is destined to be a slave in the coming Kingdom.
Her days were fulfilled: nine months had passed, and “there were twins in her womb.” Remember it said two manner of people: they are not identical, they are fraternal.

“And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment”: this child had no brown melanin in his skin. You could see the blood through this child’s skin. “And they called his name Esau”: Esau means wasted, wasted away. The way they spell it now is not the way it was originally spelled in the Hebrew; that’s how they confused everything, and Eleazar Ben Yehuda is the author of confusion.

“His hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob.” What you want to stress is that they didn’t give the color of Jacob. Why give the color of Esau and not Jacob? Because Jacob looked just like his mother and father, just like everybody from the time of Adam on up. The difference came with Esau: this guy looks different, he’s red, he has no pigmentation, no melanin in his skin.

“Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.” “And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison”: he hunted for himself, did for himself, self-sufficient. “But Rebekah loved Jacob.”
“Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint”: I ain’t found nothing to hunt and kill. “Therefore was his name called Edom.” Edom means red.

This is the blessing that came on Esau, still proving who Esau is. “Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father.” Esau cried to Isaac, I need a blessing, father, but Isaac had already given the bulk of the blessings to Jacob.

“Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth”: when you teach you’ve got to stress that the fatness of the earth means the best places on Earth. “And of the dew of heaven from above”: his people would live everywhere they want to live. Just like the dew comes from heaven and covers everything, Esau will be everywhere.

A brief history shows what this means. How did they get Europe? By the sword: the Crusaders went to war and conquered Europe, and who were they fighting? The Moors. The word Moor simply means black; the blacks were our people, and some of the Arabs were with us, but the vast majority were our people. The paintings from the Middle Ages show the Moors in the castle, because we owned Europe; that was our land. The white man were the wildlings, like the wildlings in the Game of Thrones, all with red hair. The scholars know the book, but they won’t make it plain for us; that’s why the Holy Spirit has come upon us to make it plain to the people. On the shield you see the Magen David, which is not our symbol, though we did use it; it is a sign of witchcraft. And you see the Islamic crescent moon and star: Israel and Muslims together. They conquered us and took Europe: that’s how they got England, France, Germany, all of that.

The white man tells you they got Australia through peace. That’s a lie: they slaughtered millions upon millions of our people over there. The Tasmanian devil of Bugs Bunny was a mockery of an island called Tasmania, where they slaughtered everybody, all the blacks. They took Tahiti, beautiful places, by the sword; they didn’t vote for none of these places. They have been in South Africa almost 500 years, and they got it by the sword: they conquered the Zulu nation, and many of them were Israelites, because Israel went down into the south of Africa and merged with those tribes. Don’t ever let the white man fool you and say we got it through voting or we traded it in peace. That’s a lie; they did murder by the sword.

South America by the sword: they slaughtered our people in Peru and among the Aztecs, and the Indians there were brown complexioned. In the corner you see the damnable priests with the damn crucifix, trying to christianize everybody: worship white Jesus and get water baptized before you die. They enslaved the dark-skinned Indians, baptized them in the name of white Jesus, and made them carry the wood as slaves. A lot of our people, the northern kingdom, don’t know their history at all, that in Peru and Mexico you were made slaves; the school system don’t teach it. They hanged them in the trees: cursed is everyone that hangeth on a tree, the same thing they did with Christ. Then the Spanish conquest of North America, DeSoto, Coronado, Cabeza de Vaca, all of Spain throughout the Americas, and then came the Pilgrims. The white man has never voted for anything, but he tells you and me to vote. Meanwhile they got everything through rape, robbery and bloodshed.

So “the fatness of the earth”: they live in the best places on Earth. “The dew of heaven from above”: they live everywhere. And they got it through bloodshed and war. Esau is the so-called white man of today.

“And by thy sword shalt thou live”: you want to stress that when you teach. How would they get the fatness of the earth, how would they be as the dew of heaven from above? By the sword. Esau was blessed by Isaac to have the art of war. The sword is the art of war: they were experts at war, not hand to hand but creating weaponry that can destroy their enemies.

“And shalt serve thy brother”: you will serve your brother Jacob. “When thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck”: that is when Esau broke out from underneath David and Solomon.
Now to who Amalek is. “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir”: Mount Seir is modern-day Petra. They carved it, and after Edom moved out the Arabs moved in, called the Nabataeans.

“These are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir”: Eliphaz the son of Adah, Reuel the son of Bashemath, and the sons of Eliphaz, “Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.” “And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek.” See Amalek: Amalek plays a key part in all of this world history. You have Edomites and you have Amalek.

You read about Amalek in the Book of Exodus, what they did to us; you read about Amalek in the Book of Samuel, when God said wipe them out and Saul did not. That is why we went through the genealogy: Amalek and Esau are the same race. Amalek is just one of the great grandsons.

precepts.why:
Highlight this in your Bibles. “He gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.” The city of palm trees was the land of Israel, also called Phoenicia.

Amalek always wanted the land of palm trees. Amalek wanted that land from then all the way to now; it has always been Amalek.

sense.text: This is going to kill the idea that the Arabs might be Esau. “Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”: Edom means red, meaning the blood shows through their skin. “We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen”: an ambassador is going to be risen up to turn everyone against Edom. As we read down, it pinpoints in particular the United States of America, the group that lives here. “Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.”
“Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen”: God said I made the Edomite small among the heathen. “Thou art greatly despised”: everybody hates them.

“The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee”: Edom would have a lot of pride, and God said that pride you’ve got has deceived you.

“Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock”: the clefts of the rock are the Caucasus mountains of Georgia, Russia. That’s what Caucasian means: the word Caucasian comes from the Caucasus mountains of Georgia, Russia, a range of mountains. They were pushed in there during the Dark Ages, the Middle Ages, when the Israelites, the Moors, ruled Europe; we forced them up into these mountains. These are the original cavemen. They will not teach you this in school, and they will never teach you this in church.

“Whose habitation is high”: this is why they like skyscrapers. They build skyscrapers based on the way that range of mountains is, high up in the sky.

“That saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” In order to say that, you’ve got to have power, and remember they were blessed with the sword. America will always win; the United States of America has the strongest military on Earth, and all of it goes back to them being blessed with the sword. In the first Purge with black people, all the gangs got together and they just sent drones in and took everybody out, except the brother that went under the car. How you gonna fight that with your little Glock? Are you stupid? This guy’s been blessed with war; he ain’t even got to be on your block to take you out. All he’s got to do is cut off the water. They have a navy; black people, you ain’t got no navy, and you can run to Africa, they ain’t got no good navy either, just borrowed ships. They have an air force; Africa ain’t got no good air force, and Puerto Rico and the Dominicans ain’t got no good military either. You can’t stand up against them; you’re gonna lose.

“Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle”: the Arab symbol is not the eagle. The white man’s symbol has always been the eagle, from the Greeks to the Romans to Spain to the United States of America.

“And though thou set thy nest among the stars”: when they landed on the moon in 1969, what did they say? The eagle has landed. That is Bible prophecy, and nobody can manipulate me into believing the Bible’s not true. Arabs ain’t do a damn thing; Arabs ain’t go on no moon. Some of you just don’t want to believe, because you’ve got the spirit of Satan in yourself.

“Thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord”: God said when they do it, I’ma bring you down. That’s why, when they landed on the moon, that is the time the Holy Spirit started to come on our people: wake up, you’re the Israelites; go out and teach and teach and teach. The word of God has been going out.

“I have loved you, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us?” We ask the Lord that because it seems like the Lord don’t love us: we’re in the ghetto, poverty stricken, incarcerated, on drugs, the women are just hoes, the men are delinquent dads. Where have you loved us?

But the Lord responds, “Was not Esau Jacob’s brother?” Wasn’t the white man your daddy’s brother? “Yet I loved Jacob”: yet I loved your father Jacob, I loved you.

“And I hated Esau”: whoa, that’s never been taught in church. “And laid his mountains and his heritage waste”: that was when they lived in the mountains of Georgia, Russia, the Caucasus mountains. That’s when their heritage was laid waste, “for the dragons of the wilderness”: that’s the proof, the dragons and the lizards of the wilderness, that’s what was all out in their wilderness.

“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished”: we ain’t got nothing, we’re on the bottom, because they were poverty stricken when they lived in those caves. “But we will return and build the desolate places”: write this down, the Renaissance era. They built up their cities.

“Thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down”: Christ will come and destroy everything they’ve built. They have built all of this glory; people want to come to the United States of America, Britain, London, these glorious cities. God said yeah, they’re going to rebuild, but I’m going to throw it down. “And they shall call them, The border of wickedness.”

“And, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever”: when you’re teaching you want to stress those two words, the people. The Christian will say God only hates Esau. No: the people. He has righteous anger against them for ever, and there’s nothing you can change. Some of you out there are marrying them, and God don’t give a damn. Some of you women are marrying them and having Edomite kids; God don’t give a damn. They are sealed for destruction for ever. These are them, the red people: your friend Netanyahu in Israel, that’s him too.

But don’t get it wrong. When a black man has a child with a white woman, sometimes the kids come out looking like that, and those are still Israelites. Who was David’s great grandmother, and what was she? But David was an Israelite. Those whose fathers are our seed are our people, regardless of their complexion. Teachers especially, don’t be offending people.

precepts.why:
The New Testament, for you Christians out there: “As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.” Paul had to remind us of that, because we were in school with them and hanging out with them, and he had to remind us.

That is written in case some of you have forgotten. Just like today some of you Christians have forgotten that verse in the New Testament: God loved Jacob and hated Esau.

sense.text:
The scholars know who Herod was. The Congregationalist of 1879, just after we got out of slavery, says Herod Agrippa the first, grandson of Herod the Great, educated at Rome in the court of the emperor Tiberius, was an Idumean or Amalekite, one of the hereditary enemies of the Jewish people. Herod was not an Israelite; he was an Edomite, an Amalekite. The Royal encyclopedia gives a tradition that a small number of the Amalekites colonized a part of Greece, and that from that stock the Macedonians and Spartans sprung. Not all the Spartans were Amalekites, but they are letting you know those were Amalekites.

“Because the Lord hath sworn that the Lord will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.” That was a prophecy. That is why Saul did not kill all of them. You get Christians that say Saul killed all the Amalekites. No, he didn’t. That’s why the prophecy says God is going to have war with them from generation to generation.

Clark’s Foreign Theological Library of 1888 gives the genealogy of Haman son of Hammedatha the Agagite, down through Antipater and Herod, to the red one, son of Amalek, son of Eliphaz, son of Esau. Antipater and Herod were Idumeans and therefore sons of Esau. So when you read the Book of Esther about Haman, he’s an Amalekite; they all come out of Amalek.

Saul took Agag, the king of the Amalekites, alive, a king of Edom whom God had sentenced to death. Saul kept this dude Agag because he liked him: this is a nice Edomite, he’s cool, I’ma keep him alive. Some of you at work or at school, there’s always that one Edomite you might like and that might like you. It might be the Edomite girl that smiles at you when she’s got a little bump in the back. God don’t care about that. Saul kept the best of what God had hated. Haman was an Agagite, so Haman was an Amalekite, and the Amalekites were the inveterate enemies of Israel: as Satan hated God, so Cain hated Abel, Ishmael hated Isaac, Esau hated Jacob, Amalek hated Israel, and Haman hated the Jews. And Herod the Great, who ordered the destruction of all the children in Bethlehem two years old and under in his attempt to kill the Lord Jesus, was an Edomite, an Amalekite, kin of Haman.

These are the so-called Jews; that’s the family line they come out of. Herod had to learn our customs, our traditions, our laws, his whole family, Agrippa and all of them, and they became Jewish. Esau, Amalek, Haman, Herod: those Amalekites, those Edomites, all had the spirit of Satan in them. They are Satan’s children. As it was true back then, it’s true today, and some of you still think you can change them. These are books we didn’t write; this is what their scholars put together.

That history, starting with Esau and Amalek, prefaces today’s lesson. “Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness”: write this down, the king is Christ. “And princes shall rule in judgment”: we are the princes that shall rule in judgment. That’s why it would behoove all of you to learn proper judgment, like we read earlier in Proverbs: evil men understand not judgment. Learn the scriptures; read your four chapters a day.

precepts.why: “Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.” The King that shall reign in righteousness is that righteous Branch raised unto David, Christ, and he shall execute judgment and justice in the earth. The princes that rule in judgment rule with him.

sense.text:
Paul told us this. “Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints?” Who was called the law at that time? Moses had been dead. The scribes and the Pharisees sat in Moses’ seat; they were the law. And why was the law, the Pharisees, the unjust? Because they would say and do not. They were hypocrites.

“And not before the saints”: the saints were those in Christ, those men that followed Christ.

“Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world?” We are going to judge the world, under Christ. “And if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters?”

You get people that say you can’t judge me, and you always hear black women say that, because she’s evil as hell. Monday court: who’s on that line around the corner? Black women. What are you going to court for? For the white man to judge, so you can get child support. But I thought nobody could judge? No, the white man could judge. And they’re all Christians on that family court line, and then they want to judge him: your honor, he ain’t gonna do nothing for his kids, he’s a deadbeat dad, I want half. But when you give her the law about whoremongering and to stop spreading her legs for every Tom, Dick and Harry, we know what she says: you can’t judge me. Just evil and stupid.

precepts.why:
Here’s the proof of who the law was. “The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.” They were the law.

So go back to 1 Corinthians 6:1: why was the law, the Pharisees, the unjust? Because they say, and do not. They were hypocrites, and Paul would not have the brethren go to law before them.

When the Pharisees wanted to judge Paul, what did Paul do? “Where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest. For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Cesar.”

Why did Paul want to go before Caesar and not the Jews? The Jews wanted to kill him. They were some wicked negroes; they were wicked as hell. Paul said, I’d rather be judged by the white man, because these Jews are wicked as hell.

Bring it up to today: I’d rather be judged by the white man than by some of these Israelite camps. Some of these dudes are evil as hell. There’s a picture floating around YouTube, and the comments say, how come every time there’s an altercation when UPK attacks IUIC, UPK is always locked up? Because the white man has got more sense. The white man will look at the video and say, we can see you threw the first blow, lock them up right there. That’s why Paul said no, I don’t want to be judged by these Jews, because they’re evil; I’d rather go to Caesar, to the white man, to be judged. Not that the white man’s right, but he’s got more sense than some of these evil negroes.

sense.text: “Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.” In order to rule in judgment you got to start somewhere: you got to start to learn God’s law and apply God’s law. You ain’t been taught this in church. In church you’ve been singing all your life, jumping up and down, sleeping with the boys in the choir, everybody with the women all up in there. You never learned how to rule in judgment; that’s why your house is all discombobulated, all out of whack.

“And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind”: sister, you see that. “And a covert from the tempest”: a covering from the tempest. A man shall be “as rivers of water in a dry place”, “as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.” The man shall be like a shadow: you know when it’s real hot and you got to get in some shade to get a little cool. God says the man.

Sister, I know we don’t look like nothing right now: overweight, underweight, fat, skinny, buck tooth, no tooth, half crazy, bald head, half a hair, we all jacked up. We understand it. But there is a God, and God said a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind.

precepts.why:
God is gonna make us into something; that’s what these lessons and these classes are about. He’s trying to change the mind of our people, especially you men. You must take your rightful place as leaders in order to rule with Christ, and we must start somewhere.

“I will make a man more precious than fine gold”: you see that, sister. “Even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.” That man might have been a deadbeat dad, he might have been a weed smoker; a child can change too. He might have been all them things, but if he starts to apply his mind to these laws, these statutes and these commandments, and transforms his mind, God said, I’m gonna use that guy right there.

Moses was a murderer: did he not kill an Egyptian? God said, I’m gonna use that guy right there. Paul was a murderer, and God said, I like that guy, I’m gonna use him; he was a chosen vessel. It don’t matter what life these men are in: right now we can be changed. That’s what you got to believe, no matter what lifestyle. We came, we confessed our faults: Lord, forgive us and change us. And God said, I know he don’t look like nothing right now, but I’m gonna use that one.

sense.text: “And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken”: hearken unto the word of God.

“The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge”: now we’re starting to understand the knowledge of God’s laws. “And the tongue of the stammerers”: we are the tongue of the stammerers. We “shall be ready to speak plainly.”

precepts.why: Christ said to his followers, “But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.” You hear the truth. Those are the eyes of them that see and the ears of them that hear.

What does it mean, we’re the tongue of the stammerers? “For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people”: he speaks to us. Why are we stammerers? Because we have been scattered from nation to nation, country to country, state to state, and we have learned other languages. Some of us have learned English, some of us have learned Creole, some of us Portuguese, Spanish and so forth, German, Dutch. Now we’re waking up, and we’re the stammerers because we stammer these languages.

sense.text: Now, to speak plainly. “For if that which is done away was glorious”: that which is done away is the old covenant of animal sacrifice. It was glorious at that time. “Much more that which remaineth is glorious”: what remains, the rest of them laws, are still glorious.

“Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech”. We understand the old covenant was glorious in that time, but when Christ came he took the place of animal sacrifice, for the children of Israel. The old covenant changed into the new covenant for Israel, not all people on the planet earth. That’s great plainness of speech.

So when you teach, brothers, speak plain. Don’t make it so confused that people say, what are you talking about? Like the church: we are not under the law. Shut the hell up, what are you saying, preacher? The hell is this? I ain’t learning nothing up in here. When we teach we got to make it plain to the people, not in metaphors. When we read the letters of Paul, which are written hard, we make it plain to the people: this is what it means, and these are the precepts that explain it.

“And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished”. Moses went up on the mountain and got the laws, and when he came back there was a glow on his face, so bright they had to put a veil and cover Moses’ face. That glow of light represented Christ.

What was abolished? Animal sacrifice was abolished, because Christ took its place. The old covenant was moved out the way and the new covenant came in.

precepts.why:
What is done away, and what remains? “For finding fault with them”: finding fault with Israel, “he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant”: we didn’t continue in the old covenant. “And I regarded them not”: he didn’t regard us, and we went into slavery. That’s what that means.

“For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind”: that’s the dietary law, the moral law, civil law, ceremonial law. “And write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people”. The old covenant of animal sacrifice was glorious and was done away; much more glorious is what remains, his laws put into our mind and written in our hearts.

A follow-up scripture. “Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not”: stress that, God did not want that, “neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law”: the law said to sacrifice x amount of animals on this day and that day.

“Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God”: Christ said, I come to do your will, O God. “He taketh away the first”: that’s the part about abolished in Corinthians. He taketh away the first covenant of animal sacrifice, “that he may establish the second”: that’s the second covenant.

People say, okay, so Christ came to the Israelites, he took the place of animal sacrifice to die for the sins of Israel; now what? “These all died in faith”: our forefathers. Above it talks about Abel, Enoch, Noah, Abraham. “Not having received the promises”: talking about the kingdom, “but having seen them afar off”: all of our fathers saw the kingdom afar off. “And were persuaded of them, and embraced them”: they believed in that God and embraced the teachings, “and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.” All of us are strangers and pilgrims on this earth.

“For they that say such things declare plainly”: declare plainly, brothers, speak plainly, “that they seek a country.” We seek a country, the new kingdom, New Jerusalem. It’s plain now. “And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out”, which was the old Jerusalem, “they might have had opportunity to have returned.” We have not returned, and we’re not going to return to the land until the second coming of Christ. That’s when New Jerusalem is re-established on the earth again.

sense.text: “The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.” Now we’re speaking plainly: we’re the Israelites, and the Kingdom of Heaven is for us and not you other nations. You’re going into captivity; that’s the plan. Is that plain enough for you?

“The vile person shall be no more called liberal”. Look up liberal: ‘willing to respect or accept behavior or opinions different from one’s own’, ‘open to new ideas’, ‘relating to or denoting a political and social philosophy that promotes individual rights, civil liberties, democracy and free enterprise’; synonyms ‘tolerant, unprejudiced’; ‘a supporter of policies that are socially progressive and promote social welfare.’ So a liberal will accept opinions from black and Latino people that are different from theirs. Liberals act like they want to help everybody: help black people and Latino people.

An example: in California the liberals said, you know what, black people are poor, Latino people are poor, let’s allow them to steal up to 999 dollars. Another liberal law: people like weed, Latino people like to smoke weed, let’s make a law and allow them to smoke weed. It’s state accepted; it ain’t federal, though. Now the brothers go to get a federal job and they’re told you can’t get this job. Those are the trick bags in their laws.

So the Bible says these liberals are vile. “Nor the churl said to be bountiful”: the churl is still the vile person, there’s no difference there. When you look it up, it means rude, mean-spirited: still the vile, low-life person. Said to be bountiful because they get paid: these liberals become wealthy and rich off our shortcomings.

“For the vile person will speak villany”: this liberal, which is the vile person, will speak villainy. “And his heart will work iniquity”: notice that, his heart will work iniquity, “to practise hypocrisy”: they will practise hypocrisy, “and to utter error against the Lord, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.”

Here are the liberals, in the book by Tony Martin, The Jewish Onslaught: Dispatches from the Wellesley Battlefront. The Jewish onslaught: that’s who Amalek is. Tony Martin was a tenured professor at Wellesley College. The Jewish attack on black progress reached Wellesley in 1993, when more Jewish organizations than you could shake a stick at called for his dismissal. When you are tenured it’s supposed to be hard to get fired; you put your time in, your work, your scholarship. But they got rid of him. When they don’t like you, they build a whole campaign against you, spread around the country by the major media. His crime: he included less than one day’s worth of readings on Jewish involvement in the African slave trade in his survey course on African-American history. He came across books that show so-called Jewish people were involved in our enslavement, and they said fire him, he’s teaching the students hate speech. That’s what them bastards did. It’s the same thing as your friend in Florida saying take black history out of the schools, it teaches my little white boys to hate themselves.

These are the liberal groups that claim they love everybody, all about social change, about progress. The book says these powerful Jewish groups desire to censor education, and they already control Congress through AIPAC, the American Israel Public Affairs Committee: no congressman survives who votes against Israeli interests. Remember that. Hardly an African-American individual or organization is left who has not been labeled anti-Semitic; that’s what they do. Jamie Foxx said, if they killed Jesus, what will they do to me, and he had to go and apologize over that simple statement. You can’t make this stuff up.

The entire African-American population has become fair game to have their post office boxes accessed, their Department of Motor Vehicles information divulged and confidential police files shared with the ADL, the Anti-Defamation League. That’s Jonathan Greenblatt, who was on The Breakfast Club; he loves black people. Y’all don’t know the evil these people do behind the scenes. That’s why they got rid of Tony Martin: he was finding out too much about them. The ADL boasts of its influence on hate crime legislation and on the training of police departments. I know about that one: at the academy, the first day, they told us, this is a Jewish community, and Fridays at sundown, if a Jewish person knocks on your vehicle, they need to get home across the bridge to Williamsburg, and you’re going to take them. I said I’m not taking nobody. A friend asked why they get such privilege when a lot of Dominicans live there too, and the answer was, Dominicans have no political power here; when you organize yourselves as much as these people have, then you can. Did I take somebody home for sundown? Hell no.

They want to use your past to manipulate you. In The Matrix, Mr. Smith told Neo, Mr. Anderson, one has a life and one doesn’t; he didn’t give a damn about his past. Paul was a murderer, Martin Luther King went to jail, Malcolm X went to jail; who gives a darn? The point is we change now. In Judas and the Black Messiah they got the brother on car theft and used that to manipulate him to turn traitor to his own people, and later on he committed suicide.

In a worst case scenario, the book says, a Jewish McCarthy might arise who would deprive of a livelihood any academic who believes that Jews played an important role in African slavery: that’s himself. They got rid of Tony Martin, the academic who understood Jews played an important role in African slavery, which they most assuredly did. A couple of years ago, the Jersey shooting: they said it was the Black Hebrew Israelites, with no proof. The FBI came by my house. I said show me the footage, and he said, listen, we know these are not Israelites, but that’s the narrative that was put out to all the police departments by the ADL, Jonathan Greenblatt. Those were Muslims that did that. They found a flyer in his house and used it to switch everything over to the Israelites, and then something about Yahuwah mysteriously appeared in big red letters in Jersey. Everything was planned for the people to say, let’s attack them: the same way that when they couldn’t get Christ in anything, they got men to feign themselves just men and create lies. They’re going to do the same thing again.

Joel Spingarn was a Jewish man in the NAACP. When these white people join and say, I love black people, I want to help you, they’re there to spy. Spingarn was one of several prominent Jews among the NAACP’s white liberals: there’s that word, liberal. For almost 30 years from 1910 he played major leadership roles, as both chairman of the board and president, and the NAACP got its first African-American president in 1975. Y’all thought that was a black group; it’s not a black organization. Marcus Garvey lived up to his reputation as a prophet when in 1928 he called the white NAACP leadership spies for the rest of the white race: ‘the greatest enemies of the Negro race are among those who hypocritically profess love and fellowship for him, when in truth and deep down in their hearts they despise and hate them.’ Be very mindful when white folks say they love you, I want to be with you, I want to help you. Marcus Garvey knew that. That includes you, Black Lives Matter: when the brothers went to Florida regarding the shooting, black people joined with Black Lives Matter and got the whole crowd against us.

Whatever the period, slavery, liberal or conservative, the book says the constant has been a Jewish insistence on the right to monitor the activities of African Americans. Slavery was the ultimate monitoring device; in the age of liberalism the scrutiny was exercised by those who founded, led and funded the assimilationist black organizations, from Joel Spingarn using his perch as president of the NAACP to spy for military intelligence, to Stanley Levison drafting Martin Luther King Jr.’s speeches. A Jewish man drafted I have a dream; Martin Luther King didn’t write that, the white man wrote that. That’s why they wanted that professor out of the school and his tenure taken: he was uncovering a lot. It makes sense why he says, I have a dream that one day little black boys and little white girls will hold hands. You want to hold hands with the people trying to kill you? Does that make any sense?

The book shows Israel’s nuclear collaboration with South Africa and its diamond and weapons trade with the white supremacist apartheid state, and South Africa’s Jews, beneficiaries of apartheid, were the world’s richest community. We’ve been to South Africa, Johannesburg: beautiful, no garbage on the street, it don’t even look like Africa, electric fences all around. And the black people told us, we just work here, we don’t live here; we live in Soweto.

They can never substantiate their charge of anti-Semitism, especially with the Bible, because there’s over 10 Semitic families and we are one of those families. They’d get shut down, but nobody challenges them, and when you try, they mute your mic. European Jewish scholars admit the Jews played an active and strong role in the African slave trade: they owned the ships, financed the slave hunting voyages, controlled and operated the slave auction blocks on the east coast of the United States. White women and Jews were the ones who benefited from the Civil Rights Movement of the 60s. The European Jews are not the original Semites of biblical history in the first place: they converted to Judaism in the 8th century, according to Koestler, a European Jew and author of The Thirteenth Tribe, who called the current Jews passing themselves off as descendants of the biblical Hebrews one of the biggest frauds in history.

The NAACP was formed in response to the Springfield riot by a group of black and white activists, Jews and Gentiles: William English Walling; Mary White Ovington, that’s another Edomite; Henry Moskowitz; Oswald Garrison Villard; Charles Edward Russell, another Edomite. And for the black leader, Bishop Alexander Walters, they didn’t even have the decency to get a photo; they got a drawing. The NAACP is a fraud: it has nothing to do with the advancement of colored people; it’s all for the benefit of Caucasians. And the groups: AIPAC, the American Israel Public Affairs Committee; TIP, The Israel Project; the ADL, the Anti-Defamation League, that’s Jonathan Greenblatt; the SPLC. These are all Jewish-run groups, so liberal they just love black people, yeah right. They’re for all people, but they’re really for their own interests, and one of them goes into your background and puts all your business out there to get you terminated off your job.

precepts.why:
“His bones are full of the sin of his youth”: this is the so-called white man. From the time of Cain all the way up, he’s never been judged for the crimes of his forefathers, “which shall lie down with him in the dust.”

“Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth”: wickedness is sweet in the mouth of this so-called white man. “Though he hide it under his tongue”: he’ll say, I really like you, I’m gonna do this for you; that’s him hiding it. “Though he spare it, and forsake it not”: Job is saying the evil, the wickedness, is still there, “but keep it still within his mouth.”

“Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.” Iron might be good today, but in time it will start to erode, it will start to rust. That’s how your enemy is.

“Though he humble himself”: the same thing Job said. That’s when they say, I’m sorry about the plight of the Negro, I’m sorry about what happened to your ancestors. “And go crouching”: in Black Lives Matter you had white people, white police officers, bowing to black people and saying we’re sorry. That means nothing. And this goes for the Black Hebrew Israelites too, because they love white folks to kiss their boots. Stupid as hell: they think they got a victory because some white man with a fetish comes up and kisses their boots, and they don’t know that white man was sent there. They control both sides; it’s called controlled opposition. They got agent provocateurs out there to assess how you Negroes are acting: Bill, go over there to that black guy, tell him you love him, tell him you apologize for everything done, and then you and the black guy start crying and you forget what you’re there for in the first place. Did Christ go around Jerusalem and say, I want you to bow down and kiss my feet? He never did that. So why do Black Hebrew Israelites do it? Are y’all crazy?

The pope apologizes to the Native Americans, and people say, oh Señor, he just loves you. The pope hates you; he hates your guts. Rome and Spain destroyed our people, Rome, Spain and Portugal. Never forget it. This means nothing.

Though he humble himself and go crouching and bow to you and kiss your black ashy hand, “yet take good heed and beware of him”: God says take good heed and beware of him. “And thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a lookingglass, and thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away”: you’re gonna realize his evil is still there. Through all his apologies, all his kissing of your hand, his bowing to you, kissing your boots, his wickedness is still there.

“Set him not by thee”: don’t set him by you, “lest, when he hath overthrown thee”: he will overthrow you, brothers, sisters, because you’re being simple; you’re gonna let your guard down and he’s gonna get you. “He stand up in thy place”: now he’s the Jew, I’m Jewish and you’re not. He does it with the American Indians: the Dawes Act, they paid five dollars to replace the real Indians on the reservations. Killers of the Flower Moon: a tribe was on a reservation that was garbage, then they found oil on the reservation and that tribe became very rich, very wealthy. The white man says we can’t have no goddamn Indian rich like this. He sent his men in to marry the Indian women: tell her you love her, you want to be with her; Billy Bob, you gonna do the same thing. Then the women had them in their will, and they started to get murdered, and the white man got hold of it all. It’s important because they do it today: in Liberia in Africa, and Jamaica too, white folks cannot get the land unless they’re married to one of the locals. The stupid black woman: oh, he loves me; she’s marrying a white man, a Chinese man, and all he wanted was land rights. What is wrong with our people?

“Neither let him sit at thy right hand, lest he seek to take thy seat, and thou at the last remember my words”: you’re gonna remember the words of this Bible, “and be pricked therewith.” “Who will pity a charmer that is bitten with a serpent, or any such as come nigh wild beasts?” Nobody pities a snake charmer. You shouldn’t have been playing with the snake in the first place, Billy Bob; that’s why you got bit. And the sister who married him: now he got your land, he got everything; now you’re dead and he got your land, and he killed your kids too. That’s what they do. You see these white folks playing with these animals and then they get eaten.

“So one that goeth to a sinner, and is defiled with him in his sins, who will pity? For a while he will abide with thee, but if thou begin to fall, he will not tarry”: when you fall on hard times your enemy won’t tarry with you. “An enemy speaketh sweetly with his lips”: I love black people, I love Indian people, I just want to help you, “but in his heart he imagineth how to throw thee into a pit”: that’s that movie. “He will weep with his eyes”: I love you, black people; that’s the NAACP for example, “but if he find opportunity, he will not be satisfied with blood. If adversity come upon thee, thou shalt find him there first”: you’re gonna find your enemy there first, “and though he pretend to help thee”: he pretends to help you, NAACP, “yet shall he undermine thee.” All the rights, they gave them to women, midgets and humpbacks and gays and lesbians; we didn’t get nothing. “He will shake his head, and clap his hands, and whisper much, and change his countenance”: he don’t like you; now the real him comes out.

The Bible is warning us. Our people have rejected this Bible for a long time; now we’re waking up, and it’s time for us to apply it.

“Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the Lord God of Israel”: the word adversaries means enemies. “Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do”: we serve your God too, the same God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, just like you do, “and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar–haddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.”

“But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God”. Why don’t the churches teach this? They said no, you can’t help us, we don’t want you to help us, “but we ourselves together will build unto the Lord God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.” The black church always wants to assimilate, always wants to be joined with white people; they ain’t happy unless they got white congregants, Edomite congregants.

Read the rest, because it shows the true nature of Esau. “Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building, And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.” It’s the same thing then and the same thing now. Martin Luther King had spies amongst them, in the NAACP and in SNCC: those were spies. The same thing they did to Zerubbabel, they did with Martin Luther King and the Civil Rights Movement, and when Malcolm lost his mind and started to let white people come. Our forefathers said no, y’all are the adversaries, y’all are enemies. So today we learn our lesson: gather yourselves together. The Lord wants us to do it ourselves; don’t depend on these wicked nations.

“And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.” What do we do? We separate ourselves. The churches don’t like that: oh, that ain’t what Jesus said. But Christ said, I come in the volume of the book.

Christ said it too: separate. We understand you got to work, you got to make a living; that’s not what the law is talking about. Once you leave your job, separate: he or she ain’t got to be over your house trying to marry your sister, your brother. And the ones watching that are sincere and really want to help: just send money. We don’t need no other help from you.

“Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers”: that’s our own unbelieving people too, because they got the mind of the white man, they got the mind of Esau; they will incorporate, assimilate, all of that. “For what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness? And what concord hath Christ with Belial?” Belial is the devil. “Or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?” And you sisters better understand, because y’all are the first ones to run out there and marry some unbelieving negro, then he’s popping you upside the head, bringing other women in the house, and you come to us crying. Sister, we can’t help you, you so damn stupid; we’ve been showing you these scriptures for years. Five years with a drug addict, a drug dealer, not married, and now you’re crying to us. I just wanted some good D: well, you got good D, and now where has it gotten you?

“And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God”: we are the temple of the living God. “As God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them”: them is the Israelites that repent. “And I will be their God, and they shall be my people”: my people is the Israelites. “Wherefore come out from among them”: this deals with unbelievers as well as the other nations. “And be ye separate, saith the Lord”: God says come out from among them, be separate. What are you fighting with us for when we tell you to be separate? You cursing us out, and that’s what the Lord said to do. “And touch not the unclean thing”: don’t touch their politics or religions. “And I will receive you, And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.”

sense.text:
“The vile person shall be no more called liberal”. God calls the liberal person vile; that’s what the Bible says. So when we say a liberal person is a vile person, that’s the scripture. Even Malcolm X said the white liberal is the most dangerous thing to the black community: ‘that white person that you see calling himself a liberal is the most dangerous thing in the entire Western Hemisphere,’ like a fox that comes at you smiling, and you take him for a friend. What he’s saying is the same thing God is telling us here in the scriptures. Oh, you rebellious Christians out there, you claim you love God but you reject everything you read.

“Nor the churl said to be bountiful”. That vile person is the liberal, and he is the churl, which means rude. And they’re bountiful: they get rich, they get wealthy.

“For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the Lord, to make empty the soul of the hungry”. We’re the hungry, and they make us empty. They promise us something, then they pull it back and go ‘psych, you don’t get it; we give it to the midgets and the white women and the LGBT community.’ That’s what they do.

“And he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.” We’re the thirsty. What are we hungry and thirsty for? Justice. We just want a little bit of truth and justice, and we can never get it. The Asians got a hate crime bill before black people. Are you kidding me?

“The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices”. The instruments and the devices are one and the same. “To destroy the poor with lying words”: they destroy us with lying words. They say one thing and do another.

“Even when the needy speaketh right”: even when we speak right. We say we’ve never gotten a hate crime bill in all these years we’ve been in this country. ‘Well, we think the Asians deserve one before you.’ But we’re being killed, the police killing us left and right, so many cases unsolved: the brother with his head cut open, the sister Angela Carr and the ones that got shot up in Florida, Tamir Rice. We deserve a hate crime bill. ‘No, you don’t.’ What about reparations? ‘No.’ But you gave it to the Japanese, and they suffered for five years; you gave reparations to the so-called Jewish people, and they suffered only five years. We suffered for over 400 years, and we don’t deserve a damn thing. Those are the lying words: they give our people hope, and our people roll out on hope thinking they’re going to do what they say. There’s no good thing in the white man, period.

Marginalized is the word they use about black and Latino people: treating a person or group as though they are insignificant, isolating and disempowering them, pushing them to the margins of society and rendering them powerless. Now look at the liberal devices, the programs liberals say are aimed at benefiting marginalized women of color, black and Latino women.

The Affordable Care Act, Obamacare, expanded ‘reproductive health services’ for women of color. That sounds good; women go ‘yeah, we need that.’ Reproductive: what do y’all think that’s talking about? Abortions. Kill your baby. Have sex, sex and more sex, and if you get pregnant, kill that baby. They hired a black woman to compare the states that ban abortion to the Confederacy and Jim Crow. Are you kidding me? When white people don’t want abortion, it’s not that they care about the black woman. They want to save theirs. They don’t give a damn about our children; kill all the babies you want. But they want the white woman to stop killing their babies, because white people’s numbers are going down, down, down.

WIC, the Women, Infants and Children program: nutrition for low-income pregnant women and young children. You may say, oh, that’s good. However, it keeps you dependent on the government. And when they pull the rug from under the black woman, she’s going to be surprised: ‘why they do that to me? The white man supposed to be taking care of us.’

The Violence Against Women Act. We agree there should be no violence against women. But how come the women are not taught to have one baby daddy? They’re not taught how to speak kindly, like Proverbs. They’re taught do what you want, live the way you want; it don’t matter if you have a baby, kill the baby, get with a dummy as long as he gives you what you want. Now she gets problem after problem. I’m not saying some dudes are not crazy and unstable, but I’m not talking about them. That sister that got hit with a brick was cursing out black men for not helping her, and people raised $41,000 for her on GoFundMe in one day. Then you find out she was running around smacking men in the face, one of them got sick of her and hit her with a brick. These programs about violence against women are not teaching these women how to conduct themselves at all. She was bragging that women rule, women are goddesses of the earth; nobody is telling her the Bible says to adorn yourself in modest apparel and to be shamefaced. She don’t have none of the attributes of a woman of God, and she’s acting like the damn devil and getting paid for it. Some of you married to women like that who think you don’t love them unless you hit them; ‘oh, I need a protection act.’ We don’t advocate violence; we tell you do not hit women. Any of you men with wives like that, don’t put your hands on them: leave. Don’t sit down, don’t negotiate, quietly leave the house and don’t come back, because it’s going to be she kills you, you kill her, or you wind up in jail.

Early Head Start and Head Start: early childhood education for low-income families. Now you might say that’s a good thing. But to go into the public school system your children have to get vaccinated. When I was young we got like one every other year, measles or chickenpox. Now they want to give your kids at least five at one time. If you can homeschool, that is the best. Your child had aspirations, they sent him to school, he got the shots, and now there’s a change in your child; he’s not that happy-go-lucky kid. The three levels of autism: level one requiring support, level two requiring substantial support, level three requiring very substantial support, non-speaking, rocking or spinning. And look at autism prevalence by ethnicity: black African 12.1, Somali 12.1, black Caribbean 11, white 6.3. Y’all be thinking the school system is for your benefit; no, it’s for your children’s destruction. Some of you women put your job before your child. The man is out there busting his butt paying all the bills, and you say ‘I need my own money,’ and now your child suffers the consequence: look in the mirror, mother, it’s your fault. I’m not talking about the one struggling to make ends meet; I’m talking about the one who’s got another income and doesn’t need to work but chooses money. If you think that way, don’t have no babies, then you can work for the white man all you want. The minute you put money before raising your child, you’re assisting in the further destruction of the nation. That’s why the Bible says you’re like the ostrich; the Lord gives the analogy of animals, even the sea monsters drawing out the breast, taking better care of their children than the black woman.

Expanded access to higher education: Pell Grants, student loan reforms, funding for HBCUs. Women go ‘whoa, we got higher education.’ But there’s cause and effect: the sister divorced her husband because she was making a certain amount of money, held a senior position at work, had her degree, thought she was better than him, and all the while her husband found somebody else. Some of you sisters put your education and career first, and you always end up divorced. It’s a trap, a trick. We’re not saying education is not good; education is good, but when you put that ahead of family, you got a problem.

Criminal justice reform: reducing harsh sentencing, rehabilitation, combating racial profiling. ‘Oh, that’s good.’ But it abolished cash bail for almost every offense, kidnapping, armed robbery, second-degree murder, and the criminals don’t live where the white folks are; they’re right in our communities. And then a white supremacist walked into a Dollar General in Jacksonville, Florida, and murdered three of our people. Although we thought criminal justice reform is so good, it always has a backlash on our people. That’s what liberals do.

Public assistance: welfare. They reward black women for a lifestyle of ill behavior; they reward her for being ratchet, for having baby after baby she can’t take care of. The Bible is meant to transform her, and she will only transform if she chooses to accept what the Bible says.

Public housing: ‘safe and affordable housing options for marginalized women,’ ‘stability and security.’ That sounds good. Have y’all been through the projects? Do y’all think that’s safe, especially for the sisters?

precepts.why: Who is the poor? People read this and go, oh, it’s anybody with no money. No: even if you’re rich, you’re the poor. Black men, black women, Latin men and women, even if you’re rich, you are poor. “What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.” See that: the poor of his people. The poor of Zion.

Why are we the poor? Christ explains it when the Bible talks about the poor: “Blessed are the poor in spirit”. Not poor in your pockets; poor in spirit. Why? Because we’ve lost our culture, our heritage, our identity, our land, our language; we’ve lost our God-given mind. We’ve lost everything, and Christ calls us the poor in spirit.

So Oprah is poor in spirit; Tyler Perry, poor in spirit. All of these rich black entertainers and athletes are the poor in spirit as well as us: Michael Jordan, Kanye West, all of them. And they destroy us, the poor, with lying words.

To the people with money watching who say that’s not me: this proves it is you, black people, minorities with money, out of Christ’s own mouth. “Because thou sayest, I am rich”: that’s you, look at my house, my job, my bank account. “And increased with goods”: because of the material things you have, you think you’re better off than the poor folk. “And have need of nothing”: I don’t need nothing, the white man has provided for me, look how good I’m living.

“And knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor”. God says you’re wretched and miserable and poor. This is for you uppity black folk that think just because you got a good education and a good job, look what the white man gave me: you are poor according to what Christ says. “And blind”: you don’t see that this scripture is for you and your nation and your family; just because you’re doing good and other people are doing bad doesn’t mean you’re well off. “And naked”: naked to the covering. The scriptures say put on the whole armour of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil, and you’re falling for it because you’re not armed up.

Public housing is in the Bible. “Woe unto them that join house to house”: they put all the houses together, they lump everybody together. “That lay field to field, till there be no place”: no more room. “That they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!” So that the white man can live by himself somewhere in a far secluded area. They put all of us together: y’all live over here in these areas called the projects. Then the white man goes, we’re going to live way back over there by ourselves, and they got four acres of land, five acres of land. How much land you got in the projects? Zero.
